  18  ``doc_id``) and executes queries built from :class:`~tinydb.queries.Query` and
  19  :class:`~tinydb.queries.QueryInstance`.

  22  as :class:`~tinydb.storages.JSONStorage` and

  24  :class:`~tinydb.middlewares.Middleware` implementations like
